purpose: Calibrate future absolute surface-hygiene thresholds from human broadcast scripts rather than contaminated model Control/Treatment outputs.

source_policy.primary: Frozen human-broadcast-script subset available under existing licensed/authorized Literary OS research corpus boundaries.
source_policy.exclude: Any Literary OS generated Control/Treatment surface, any script used to tune the candidate threshold, any uncertain provenance sample.
source_policy.stratify_by: genre, episode length, scene count band, production format where metadata exists

threshold_policy.report_distribution: median, IQR, 90th, 95th, 99th percentile where N supports it
threshold_policy.gate_selection: Choose thresholds prospectively with a declared false-reject tolerance on human references; do not optimize for passing current Literary OS outputs.

regression_requirement: Any future absolute surface gate must fail the sealed I4K-4 contamination case while retaining an acceptable share of frozen human references, otherwise the gate is not accepted.
claim_boundary: Calibration defines future experiment admission rules only. It cannot retrospectively change historical experiment verdicts or current frozen R4A PASS/FAIL rules.
next_legal_action: Identify the exact eligible human-reference subset and seal its file IDs/hashes before measuring distributions.
